title: The Architecture of Oppenheimer
description: How Nolan visualizes the invisible forces of quantum mechanics and guilt.
author: Elena Rostova

body.raw: Christopher Nolan’s *Oppenheimer* is less a traditional biopic and more an architectural study of guilt. By structuring the film around the twin hearings of Oppenheimer and Strauss, Nolan creates a fission/fusion dynamic...
